messages:
PagerDuty: [PAGER] High error-rate detected: US-EAST inference cluster 5xx surge. Affected routes: /v1/chat (connection resets), /v1/embeddings (timed out), /v1/rerank (cpu OOM). Alert window: 09:23-09:25 UTC. Pager: Maya (primary). Incident ID INC-2025-0924-02

Maya: I'm on. quick ask: are we seeing a customer traffic spike or internal batch job?

Noah: telemetry -> sudden increase in high-dimension embeddings and long-chat sequences from multi-tenant pool at 09:21. Not a scheduled job. Top offending agent: prod-ingest-42.

Priya: memory pressure on several pods. KV cache churn high; eviction rate ~3x baseline. Some pods hitting 95% GPU mem.

Maya: live mitigation plan: 1) apply route-specific token-bucket for embeddings to protect control plane 2) reduce max_payload_size for chat to prevent extremely long requests 3) throttle rerank and send 429 with retry-after 4) prefer fallback embeddings model (quantized) for non-enterprise tenants. Ops-Automation, execute please.

Ops-Automation: running commands now.

```
# 1) token-bucket for /v1/embeddings: 100 tokens/sec, burst 200
POST /internal/ratelimit
{"route":"/v1/embeddings","strategy":"token_bucket","rate":100,"burst":200}

# 2) chat max_payload change
POST /internal/route-config
{"route":"/v1/chat","max_tokens":2048}

# 3) rerank throttle -> 429
POST /internal/route-config
{"route":"/v1/rerank","action":"throttle","status":429,"retry_after":30}
```

Ops-Automation: all configs pushed, edge invalidated, rollout 60s.

SRE-Bot: metrics update +30s: embeddings timeouts down 55%, rerank requests 0.3 RPS (throttled), chat p95 reduced ~20% for short requests, but p99 still high for sequences > 2k tokens.

Noah: adding tenant-aware fallback for embeddings. rule: if customer_tier != "enterprise" -> route to emb-small-quantized; enterprise -> emb-large. Applying now.

Priya: note: emb-small-quantized has lower mem and latency but lower dimensionality. Might affect similarity scores. Emma-CS: can you prepare messaging for customers who may see slight embedding vector changes?

Emma-CS: yes. I'll notify accounts for any detectable quality delta. prepping template: "temporary change to embeddings model for some tenants, expected minimal impact to recall, will revert after stabilization."

Maya: good. Also enable a soft quota per-API-key: max_concurrent_requests=2 for embeddings to limit bursts. Ops-Automation?

Ops-Automation: applied per-key concurrency cap for embeddings: 2 concurrent, global burst queueing enforced.

SRE-Bot: after per-key cap and model fallback: overall 5xx -> 0.9%, embeddings latency 60% improvement for non-enterprise, chat memory pressure trending down.

Priya: investigating root cause: high-dim payloads combined with repeated long-prefix caching causing KV eviction cascade. Hypothesis: a rogue client sending repeated 150k-d vector requests. Noah, can you pull recent request samples (IDs) and IPs?

Noah: pulling now. top offender API key: key_abcd1234, approx 1.2k requests in 2m, avg dims 1536, many concurrent.

Maya: block key_abcd1234 temporarily (throttle to 0). Ops-Automation? include note for support.

Ops-Automation: blocked key_abcd1234. Responses are now 403 with body {"error":"temporarily blocked due to abusive usage"}.

Emma-CS: Customer contact: the offending key belongs to a smaller partner; I'll open outreach and explain temporary block + remediation.

SRE-Bot: summary 09:45 UTC: incident mitigated to low severity. Active mitigations: embeddings token-bucket (100 tps), per-key concurrency 2, embedding model fallback for non-enterprise, chat max_tokens=2048, rerank throttled with 429, offending API key blocked.

Maya: I'll hand off to Noah for RCA and postmortem. Noah, include timeline, metrics, mitigation commands, and a runbook item: add automatic detection for high-dimension burst patterns and per-key emergency throttle rule.

Noah: taking ownership. immediate actions: gather traces, heap dumps from affected pods, check autoscaler behavior during spike, and review model warming logic. Will post updates here.

Priya: ops note: consider lowering default emb max_dims or applying a soft-dimension cap at the router to avoid unbounded mem usage.

Maya: agreed. add action item in postmortem. Also schedule a game-day to test per-endpoint fallback.

Noah: one more: I'm saving the mitigation commands to runbook under /docs/incidents/INC-2025-0924-02-runbook.md

SRE-Bot: incident INC-2025-0924-02: status -> mitigated, owner -> Noah, follow-ups -> postmortem, customer comms, automated detection rules.

Maya: closing live page. keep thread open for RCA updates. thanks all. :sparkles:
